hero.title: A unique experience in the heart of Sicily

home.welcome_subtitle: Your oasis of comfort overlooking Sicily
home.welcome_text1: Nestled in the beauty of Piazza Armerina, PanoramaSuite welcomes you with two exclusive suites designed to provide maximum comfort in an elegant and refined atmosphere.
home.welcome_text2: Enjoy the breathtaking panoramic views of the city, lovingly prepared breakfasts every morning, and the authentic hospitality of the Caruso family.

suites.title: Our Suites
suites.subtitle: Two exclusive suites for an unforgettable stay
suites.double_short: Double suite with modern furnishings and panoramic views
suites.double_desc: Our Double Room is a double suite furnished with modern taste, featuring a private bathroom with spacious shower, Smart TV, free Wi-Fi and a stunning panoramic view of Piazza Armerina. Continental breakfast is included every morning.
suites.king_short: Suite with king-size bed and authentic Sicilian details
suites.king_desc: The King Room is our most exclusive suite, with a king-size bed and contemporary style enriched with Sicilian details. It features a private bathroom, Smart TV, free Wi-Fi and a wonderful panoramic view. Continental breakfast is included every morning.

gallery.title: Photo Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Discover the landscapes and spaces of PanoramaSuite

servizi.title: Our Services
servizi.subtitle: Complete hospitality to make your stay perfect
servizi.colazione_desc: Every morning a rich continental breakfast awaits you, prepared with fresh, quality products, served on our terrace with panoramic views.
servizi.wifi_desc: High-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the property, completely free for all guests during their stay.
servizi.parking_desc: Free private parking directly on our property, safe and convenient for the entire duration of your stay.
servizi.electric_desc: Electric vehicle charging station available for a fee, for those who travel sustainably and responsibly.
servizi.cleaning_desc: Daily cleaning service to ensure maximum hygiene and comfort in our suites throughout your stay.
servizi.restaurant_desc: Personalized recommendations and reservations at the best local restaurants, to fully experience the extraordinary Sicilian cuisine.
servizi.linen_desc: Regular linen change service to always ensure freshness and maximum comfort during your stay.
